summary: AKERSHUS HOLDING AS (org. no. 917 824 355) is a private limited company (AS) based in Bærum, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2016-10-04. It is under liquidation. Its main activity is NACE 71.121 (Byggeteknisk konsulentvirksomhet); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was -NOK 35 453. Board chair: Eric Gil.
